summary: 植物散发的挥发性气味能吸引传粉者、驱避植食动物，也能间接招来害虫的天敌。作物育种可能无意间削弱花香，研究者因此关注如何恢复适合传粉者的气味。
logic: 探索果园和观赏花卉的育种选择

paragraphs.brief: 人类可能认为香水是一种植物用来诱导授粉者、抑制细菌或保护捕食者的工具。
sentences: Many plants emit a smell.
很多植物都散发出一种味道
This may come from the flower of the plant, from the leaves, stem, or even, in some cases, from the root.
这可能是植物的花朵树叶干叶在某些情况下甚至根部
What humans may perceive as a fragrant perfume is actually a tool used by plants to entice pollinators, discourage bacteria, or fend off predators.
人类可能认为香水是一种植物用来诱导授粉者、抑制细菌或保护捕食者的工具。

Fragrances consist of small organic particles with high vapor pressures, so that a scent compound evaporates easily if exposed to the air; chemicals which evaporate in this way are described as ‘volatile compounds’.
芳香由蒸气压力高的小有机颗粒组成，因此，如果接触空气，气味化合物很容易蒸发；以这种方式蒸发的化学品被称为“挥发性化合物”。

paragraphs.brief: 虽然我们一般认为植物的气味是愉快的，但植物中许多挥发性化合物在被食用时有毒。
sentences: Although we generally think of plant odors as pleasant, many volatile compounds in plants are toxic when eaten.
虽然我们一般认为植物的气味是愉快的，但植物中许多挥发性化合物在被食用时有毒。
These compounds are used by plants to protect themselves from bacterial attack.
这些化合物被植物用来保护自己免受细菌攻击。
Humans have recognized and taken advantage of these plant-derived antibacterials since antiquity, when they were used to slow the spoilage of food.
人类认识到并利用这些植物衍生的抗菌剂，自古以来，它们就被用来减缓食物的变质。
For example, the spice clove could be used in baked goods and prepared meats to slow the growth of mould and bacteria, because a small amount was not dangerous to humans.
例如，香料丁香可以用于烘烤商品和制成肉类，以减缓铸模和细菌的生长，因为少量的香料对人类并不危险。
Before the development of modern food preservation techniques, European civilization was heavily dependent on cloves and other tropical spices to ensure a long-lasting supply of food.
在开发现代食品保存技术之前，欧洲文明严重依赖丁香和其他热带香料，以确保长期供应食品。

However, the long distance from Europe to South-east Asia made these spices extremely expensive and was part of the motivation behind the search for a shorter route to Asia, which resulted in the discovery of the Americas.
然而，从欧洲到东南亚的漫长距离使得这些香料变得极其昂贵，并且是寻求缩短通往亚洲的路线的动机之一，这导致了美洲的发现。

paragraphs.brief: 虽然植物中的挥发性化合物最初可能是为了击退各种食用植物的动物而演变的，但现在这些动物的功能范围很广。
sentences: Although volatile compounds in plants probably originally evolved to repel herbivorous (plant-eating) animals of all kinds, they now perform a remarkable range of functions.
虽然植物中的挥发性化合物最初可能是为了击退各种食用植物的动物而演变的，但现在这些动物的功能范围很广。
An important one common to many plants is to attract animals which will spread that plant’s pollen.
吸引动物来散播植物花粉是许多植物共有的重要一环。
Insects are the most common animals to interact with plants in this way, and most insects detect volatile compounds through the extremely sensitive antennae on their heads.
昆虫是以这种方式与植物进行互动的最常见动物，大多数昆虫通过头顶上极为敏感的天线探测到挥发性化合物。
Some antennae can detect an airborne volatile compound at concentrations of just a few parts per billion.
有些天线可以探测到空气中的挥发性化合物，其浓度仅为10亿分之几。

paragraphs.brief: 其他植物则排放挥发性化合物，作为毒素来对付入侵的昆虫，还有一些植物则在受伤时释放这种化合物，以阻止昆虫在它们身上下蛋，从而进一步伤害它们。
sentences: Other plants emit volatile compounds which function as toxins against invading insects, and still others emit such compounds when they have been injured, in order to deter insects from laying eggs on them and thus injuring them further.
其他植物则排放挥发性化合物，作为毒素来对付入侵的昆虫，还有一些植物则在受伤时释放这种化合物，以阻止昆虫在它们身上下蛋，从而进一步伤害它们。
Volatile compounds released by plants in response to herbivore egg-laying, for example, can attract parasites of the eggs, thereby preventing them from hatching.
例如，植物因产卵而释放的挥发性化合物可以吸引卵的寄生虫，从而防止它们孵化。
In this way the plant can avoid the attack of the hungry young herbivores that would have emerged from the eggs.
这样，植物可以避免饥饿的年轻食草动物从卵中冒出来的攻击。

paragraphs.brief: 工厂中的挥发性化合物也可以作为某种货币，用于一些非常间接的防御系统。
sentences: Volatile compounds in plants can also be used as a kind of currency in some very indirect defensive systems.
工厂中的挥发性化合物也可以作为某种货币，用于一些非常间接的防御系统。

In the rainforest tree Leonardoxa africana, for example, ants of the species Petalomyrmex phylax are attracted to young leaves because they emit high levels of the volatile compound methyl salicylate, a substance that ants need to use as an antiseptic in their nests; coincidentally, the ants attack any herbivorous insects that they encounter.
例如，在非洲热带雨林树中，白蛋白植物的蚂蚁被幼叶吸引，因为它们排放高浓度的挥发性化合物甲基硅酸盐，蚂蚁需要将这种物质用作巢穴中的抗菌剂；巧合的是，蚂蚁会攻击它们遇到的任何食草昆虫。
It appears that methyl salicylate both attracts ants and rewards them for performing their valuable role in deterring herbivores.
甲基盐酸盐似乎既吸引蚂蚁，又奖励他们在阻吓食草动物方面发挥的宝贵作用。
The web of interactions among plants and animals can become so complicated that it is difficult to detect what the outcome of the release of volatile compounds is.
植物和动物之间的相互作用网络可能变得如此复杂，以至于难以发现挥发性化合物释放的结果是什么。
But it is clear that the system can have a defensive purpose, as many experiments have shown that the deactivation of a plant’s volatile emission system makes it more vulnerable to herbivores.
但显然，这个系统可以有防御性目的，因为许多实验已经表明，工厂挥发性排放系统的停用使得它更容易受到食草动物的伤害。

paragraphs.brief: 花香对依赖昆虫授粉者的许多农作物的经济成功有着重大影响，包括蜜蜂授粉樱桃、苹果、杏仁和桃子等果树，以及蔬菜和木瓜等热带植物。
sentences: Floral scent has a strong impact on the economic success of many agricultural crops that rely on insect pollinators, including fruit trees such as the bee-pollinated cherry, apple, apricot, and peach, as well as vegetables and tropical plants such as the papaya.
花香对依赖昆虫授粉者的许多农作物的经济成功有着重大影响，包括蜜蜂授粉樱桃、苹果、杏仁和桃子等果树，以及蔬菜和木瓜等热带植物。
A decrease in fragrance emission, due to crossbreeding for fruit size or other characteristics, reduces the ability of plants to attract pollinators and may result in considerable losses for growers.
由于水果尺寸或其他特性的交叉繁殖，香气排放减少，削弱了植物吸引授粉者的能力，并可能导致种植者遭受重大损失。
This problem has been made worse in the United States by recent epidemics that have infected and killed many honeybees, the major insect pollinator.
在美国，由于最近的流行病感染和杀害了许多蜜蜂，即主要昆虫授粉者，这一问题变得更加严重。

paragraphs.brief: 一些植物育种者试图通过在果园树上喷洒气味化合物，加强蜜蜂饲料，来解决授粉问题，但这种方法成本高昂，最终证明效率低下。
sentences: Some plant breeders have tried to solve this pollination problem by spraying scent compounds on orchard trees to enhance honeybee foraging, but this approach was costly and, in the end, proved to be inefficient.
一些植物育种者试图通过在果园树上喷洒气味化合物，加强蜜蜂饲料，来解决授粉问题，但这种方法成本高昂，最终证明效率低下。
One of the reasons for its ineffectiveness was that general spraying of the crop could not tell insects exactly where the blossoms were.
其无效的原因之一是，对作物的一般喷洒无法确切地说明昆虫的花朵在哪里。
Clearly, a more refined strategy is needed; genetic manipulation of scents, for example, would allow growers to regulate the types of insect pollinators and the frequency of their visits.
显然，需要一项更完善的战略；例如，对气味的基因操纵将使种植者能够管制昆虫授粉者的类型和访问次数。

paragraphs.brief: 切花和栽培植物在人类生活中发挥了重要的审美作用。
sentences: Such manipulation of scent will also benefit people who grow flowers commercially.
这种对气味的操纵也有利于那些以商业方式种植花卉的人。
Cut flowers and potted plants play an important aesthetic part in human life.
切花和栽培植物在人类生活中发挥了重要的审美作用。
Unfortunately, traditional breeding has produced varieties with improved vase life, color, and shape, while perfume has been sacrificed.
不幸的是，传统的繁殖方式产生了各种改良的花瓶生命、颜色和形状，而香水则被牺牲了。
The loss of scent among ornamental flowers, which have a worldwide annual value of more than US$30 billion, makes them important targets for the genetic manipulation of flower fragrance.
观赏花朵的气味丧失，每年在全世界价值超过300亿美元，因此这些花朵成为花香基因操纵的重要目标。

Some preliminary experiments have already been carried out, but for technical reasons the scent was present in every part of the plant, rather than being localized in the flower, and the level of intensity of fragrance was below the threshold of detection for the human nose.
已经进行了一些初步试验，但由于技术原因，植物的每一个部分都含有气味，而不是花朵中的地方化，香气的强度低于探测人鼻的门槛。

The next generation of experiments, already in progress, will include more sophisticated schemes that target the expression of scent specifically to flowers or other organs, such as special glands that can store antibacterial or herbivore-repellent compounds.
已经进行的下一代实验将包括更先进的计划，专门针对花卉或其他器官，例如能够储存抗菌性或食草性腐蚀性化合物的特殊腺的气味表达。

items.en: a list of food plants which need insects to make them productive
items.zh: 需要昆虫生产的食物植物清单
items.why: 题干要“清单川st,F 段给出具体作物名称并点明它们依赖昆虫传粉，完全对应。

items.en: an explanation of why a genetic experiment may assist plant reproduction
items.zh: 解释基因实验为何有助于植物繁殖
items.why: G段提出调节花香可影响哪些昆虫前来授粉以及访花频率，因此可能帮助植物繁殖。

items.en: a description of current research with advantages for the flower industry
items.zh: 对花卉产业有利的当前研究说明
items.why: 既明确“受益对象=花卉产业”,又说明“目前/正在进行的研究”,与题干完全吻合。

items.en: an explanation of how insects perceive volatile compounds in plants
items.zh: 解释昆虫如何看待植物中的挥发性化合物
items.why: C 段给出感知器官 (触角) 与灵敏度 (ppb 级),正是“how insects perceive”.

items.en: According to the passage, spices were used in the past to
items.zh: 根据这段话香料过去用来

items.en: The Leonardoxa africana tree protects itself by
items.zh: 莱昂纳多卡非洲树保护自己
correct: attracting an enemy of herbivorous insects.

items.en: Which of the following statements about methyl salicylate is NOT true according to the passage?
items.zh: 有关甲基硅酸盐的以下说法中，有哪一点根据段落是不真实的？
correct: It helps herbivorous insects to find food.
它帮助食草昆虫寻找食物。

items.en: Which factor has made the problems of US fruit growers more serious?
items.zh: 哪个因素使美国水果种植者的问题变得更加严重？
correct: Bees have had their numbers reduced by disease.
蜜蜂的数量因疾病而减少

items.en: Experiments in genetically manipulating the fragrance of ornamental flowers have
items.zh: 基因操纵观赏花香的实验
correct: failed to produce a strong enough scent.

items.en: The theory that plants defend themselves with smells is untested.
items.zh: 植物用气味来保护自己的理论是未经测试的。
items.why: 已有多项实验发现，抑制植物挥发性物质的释放会减弱其防御能力，不能说这一观点未经检验。

items.en: The smell from fruit-tree flowers is important to farmers.
items.zh: 果树花的味道对农民很重要。
items.why: “经济成功”= 对农民/种植者的重要性，故 TRUE。

items.en: The population of honeybees in Europe has declined.
items.zh: 欧洲的蜜蜂人口已经减少。
items.why: 地域限定为美国，对欧洲没有信息，因此 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: Applying perfume to orchard trees is accepted as a good method of increasing pollination.
items.zh: 将香水应用于果园树被认为是增加授粉的一个好方法。
items.why: 被证实效率低，并非“好方法/被接受",所以 FALSE。
